title: Pre-Registration
summary: The trial budget was committed to git before any sleeve touched the data lake. Every config that could have been measured counts toward the deflation denominator, so a tiny budget measured once is the only honest path to a clean grade.
commit_basis: the git commit hash of the document is its timestamp of record
measure_once_protocol: No re-runs, no re-windowing, no cadence search, no sign-flips, no subset search over sleeve combinations, no MVO, no static scheme in the deployable path. KILL = exclude, never re-tune.

slots.name: Momentum (12-1)
slots.note: Deployed as the frozen 2023+ k30_dn_63 sleeve at Sharpe 0.9071. The deep-history pre-reg variant scored -0.0493 and failed the DSR gate; the clean sleeve is used.

slots.name: Value (composite)
slots.note: Net Sharpe -0.5994 below the 0.30 gate. Killed.

slots.name: Quality (GP/A + ROE)
slots.note: Net Sharpe -0.8316 below the 0.30 gate. Killed.

slots.name: Betting-Against-Beta (low-risk)
slots.note: Net Sharpe -0.0679, failed the DSR >= 0.95 gate. Killed.

slots.name: Combined book (one fixed combiner)
slots.note: Structure survives (PIT-clean, decorrelated) but the in-sample magnitude fails multiple-testing deflation. Recorded as the honest null; the path is forward live evidence, not a re-combine.

slots.name: Crypto-carry satellite (re-measured once)
slots.note: Net Sharpe 0.6766, kept as a capacity-capped satellite (finite ~$100k to $1M, decays above ~$100M AUM).

slots.name: Contingency reserves
slots.note: Spendable only against a structural trigger logged before its result is seen.

gates.equity_momentum: DSR >= 0.95 AND net Sharpe >= 0.40 AND rank-IC NW t >= 3.0 AND PBO < 0.5 AND SPA p < 0.05 AND positive in >= 3 of 4 sub-periods
gates.value: net Sharpe >= 0.30 AND mean-return NW t >= 2.0 AND rank-IC >= 0.015 (t >= 2.0) AND positive in BOTH pre/post-2013 halves
gates.quality: net Sharpe >= 0.30 AND DSR >= 0.95 AND PBO < 0.5 AND rank-IC NW t >= 2.0
gates.bab: beta-hedged return NW t >= 2.0 AND DSR >= 0.95 AND net Sharpe >= 0.35
gates.book: DSR >= 0.95 AND PBO < 0.5 AND SPA p < 0.05 AND market-neutral (|beta_SPY|, |beta_BTC| t < 2)

expected_outcome: B+ to A-, honest combined Sharpe ~0.75-0.85 net (NOT 1.46)
actual_outcome: C+ honest null. The free-breadth path is exhausted: value and quality do not replicate on the narrow universe; crypto-perp alone fails honest deflation. The deployed book is the two survivors, awaiting forward live proof.
